title: Computer Architecture
weeklyTopics: VeriSimpleV: pipelined RISC-V, hazard detection and forwarding
Out-of-order scheduling algorithms for instruction-level parallelism
workloadNotes: Four individual programming/design assignments (priority selectors; pipelined multiplier/synthesis; VeriSimpleV hazard handling) building toward a semester-long term project: teams of 5 build an out-of-order RISC-V processor on top of the Project 3 pipeline. Term project grading (internal to that project, not the overall course weighting): base features 25%, correctness/testing 20%, performance 20%, optional features 15%, analysis 10%, documentation 7%, checkpoints 3%. Overall course-level weighting between the 4 projects and any exams was not recoverable from this source.
